text:
sasha: quick flag — p95 for /v1/generate in the new latency dashboard is higher than raw histogram + logs. p50 looks consistent though. noticed after the rollout of route-weighting change. can someone eyeball?
lin: looking. is this on the 'rollup=route' view or per-endpoint atomization?
sasha: rollup=route. per-endpoint median matches but p95 seems pulled up. probably aggregation mix
omar: could be sampling weights. we moved to weighted t-digest rollups last week. if sample tags aren't propagated (client->route) the rollup may merge wrong cohorts.
maia: pinging deploy-bot to check if last change touched telemetry tagging.
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-13T15:07Z rolled: eng-platform/rollup-weighted-tdigest v2.3 -> v2.4 by lin. no data-schema migrations.
lin: confirmed we didn't change tag propagation, but the route fallback logic got a small tweak: requests with null route now go to default-route bucket for rollups. that could merge high-latency fallbacks with normal traffic.
sasha: aha. how easy is it to rehydrate the rollup with route tag split for last 24h? customers using endpoint-level SLOs are going to be confused.
omar: we can reprocess but it's expensive. alternative: expose 'sample_origin' toggle in dashboard to show raw sample counts vs weighted counts. that buys time.
maia: UX note — the dashboard currently shows 'p95 (merged)' label but not the aggregation mode. users assume it's raw percentile. we should surface 'aggregation: weighted t-digest' next to metric name.
lin: agree. also we should add a small footnote explaining that p50 is computed per-sample and p95 uses tdigest rollup. short-term fix: add tooltip and an 'as-sampled' checkbox.
sasha: can we also add endpoint drilldown that shows both 'route-annotated' and 'fallback' buckets? then product can decide which p99 to trust.
omar: wrote a quick query to show the issue:
```sql
SELECT route, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) FROM rollups
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours'
AND endpoint = '/v1/generate'
GROUP BY route;
```
omar: if default-route shows p95 >> per-endpoint raw, that's the culprit.
lin: i'll revert the fallback-to-default-rollup in the runtime for a hotfix now, then we can decide reprocess vs UX.
maia: also add an alert that fires when p95 diverges from histogram p95 by >20% for a single endpoint — helps catch regressions.
sasha: thanks. can you post the revert PR here? i'll notify support so they don't escalate.
lin: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rollup-runtime/pulls/789 — rolling back change, will push in 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-platform/rollup-runtime v1.8.3 -> v1.8.2 by lin.
maia: UX ticket: https://tickets.redwood/PLAT-1234 created for 'Aggregation mode label + as-sampled toggle'
omar: after revert if we still see skew we should schedule reprocess window and cost estimate.
sasha: great. marking this thread done unless new anomalies show. :thumbsup:
